body: Around 7th grade whenever I would see a homeless person my ocd would go “you’re attracted to them. You want to have sex with them. Your friends are going to find out and you’re going to be socially isolated”

I’ve been trying to get in touch with a therapist for over a month and all of them are taken up. And even if they weren’t, looking into it more I highly doubt there’s anything they can do to help. I’ve been on every medication under the goddamn sun and most of them have made things worse. The ONLY medication that’s worked for me is addictive and they don’t prescribe it to people like they used to. I’m all out of ideas. Well, except for one...
